table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	Patient     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,
	saleperson = (SELECT SM.name FROM Salesman SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = dbo.saleledger.smancode), 
	rowid = dbo.saledetail.rowid,
	looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = dbo.saledetail.bonusqty, 
	machinename=saleledger.machinename,
	rate=saledetail.rate,
	machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=saleledger.salesmancode),
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name 	end,
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = saledetail.packqty,  
	price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.saledetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry,    
	salestax  = saledetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	itemdescription = dbo.saledetail.saleitemdescription,
	unitsalestax = dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = dbo.saledetail.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			/*invoice level salestax*/
			Round(Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
				* ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 ) + 
			/*items salestax*/
				Sum (Round ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ), 0 )
		FROM 
			dbo.saleledger SL, 
			dbo.saledetail SD
		WHERE  
			(SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
			(SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
		GROUP BY 
			SL.misccharges,   
			 SL.flatdisc,   
			 SL.date,   
			 SL.saleinvcode, 
			 SL.invgstperc1, 
			 SL.discperc,  
			 SL.salestax),
	Stock = dbo.saledetail.godownbalancestock
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ai_sinvcode and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ai_linvcode  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	impactinventory = dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	Patient     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,	
	saleperson = (SELECT SM.name FROM Salesman SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = dbo.saleledger.smancode), 
	rowid = sd.rowid,
	looseqty = sd.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = sd.bonusqty, 
	machinename=saleledger.machinename,
	rate=sd.rate,
	machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=saleledger.salesmancode),
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=sd.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = 0,  
	price = sd.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = sd.discperc,    
	packunits = sd.packunits,    
	batch = sd.batch,    
	expiry = sd.expiry,    
	salestax  = 0.00,
	itemname = item.name,
	itemdescription = sd.saleitemdescription,
	unitsalestax = sd.unitsalestax ,    
	gstperc = sd.gstperc ,    
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
		/*invoice level salestax*/
			Round (Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SDD.looseqty * ( SDD.saleprice - SDD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SDD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
				* ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 ) + 
		/*items salestax*/
			Sum (Round ((SDD.looseqty + SDD.bonusqty) * SDD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SDD.looseqty * (SDD.saleprice - SDD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SDD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SDD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ), 0 )
		FROM 
			dbo.saleledger SL , 
			dbo.saleinvdetail SDD
		WHERE  
			(SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
			(SL.saleinvcode = SDD.saleinvcode )   
		GROUP BY 
			SL.misccharges,   
			 SL.flatdisc,   
			 SL.date,   
			 SL.saleinvcode, 
			 SL.invgstperc1, 
			 SL.discperc,  
			 SL.salestax),
	Stock = 0.0000
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,     
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ai_sinvcode and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ai_linvcode  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	sd.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
Order By 
	saleinvcode,
	rowid

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( (  (looseqty + bonusqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum((((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ))  *  invdiscperc  * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: sum( totalsalestax for all Distinct saleinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(   c_amount  for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum( flatdisc  for all distinct saleinvcode) -   compute_4 , 0)

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  saleinvcode  )  +  compute_4

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum( misccharges for all Distinct   saleinvcode  )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( c_amount for all) + sum ( misccharges for all distinct  saleinvcode ) -  sum ( flatdisc  for all distinct saleinvcode ) - Sum(  Round ( ( ( looseqty   *  price  ) - ( itemflatdisc *  looseqty) )    *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) * (   invdiscperc  * 0.01 )   , 2)   for all ) , 0)  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax  for all distinct saleinvcode ) , 0 )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( ( looseqty   *  price  )  -  ( looseqty   *  itemflatdisc  ) ) *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  )-( itemflatdisc * looseqty ))  *  ( 1 - (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2) *  ( 1 - invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)  +  Round ( totalsalestax, 0 )
